_comment: Every npm lifecycle script in a committed package-lock.json must be listed here with a rationale, or CI fails. Adding an entry is a security decision, not a chore. Script bodies were read from the registry on 2026-11-03 with `npm view <name>@<version> scripts --json`.
policy: Lockfile-aware only. `npm ci --ignore-scripts` is not yet enforced repo-wide; the gate prevents NEW install-script packages from entering the tree. Removing an entry is safe; adding one requires review of the script body.

allowed.rationale: Vite/esbuild native binary installer. Version is pinned by frontend/package.json `overrides.esbuild = 0.25.12`; esbuild also ships platform binaries as optionalDependencies so --ignore-scripts is viable. Candidate for removal in the dependency diet.

Transitive of legacy svelte-i18n/deepmerge chain. Opaque dynamic require of an in-package file, silently swallowing errors: highest-risk script in the tree. Approved temporarily because no IOC matches its pinned version; remove when the svelte-i18n/deepmerge chain is dropped (Tier 2).
macOS-only optional dependency (os: darwin). Not installed on Linux CI runners. Native build script, no network fetch in the script body.
Nested macOS-only optional fsevents for playwright 1.62.1; same as above.

allowed.script: install: node install/check.js || npm run build
allowed.rationale: Root-level image tooling (sharp 0.34.5); native libvips binding check/build. Direct dependency, version pinned in package.json.
macOS-only optional dependency in the Sabi subtree; not installed on Linux.
